questions.question: How does the user of Ratio Technique mark their target's body?
questions.subject: Ratio Technique

answer.item: The user of this technique can mark their target's body with lines divided into tenths.

questions.question: What happens when the user strikes one of the marked lines on exactly the seven-to-three ratio point?
questions.subject: Ratio Technique

answer.item: If the user is able to strike one of these lines on exactly the seven-to-three ratio point, they deliver a critical hit to the subject.

questions.question: How did Nanami dominate Haruta Shigemo during the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Ratio Technique

answer.item: During the Shibuya Incident, Nanami dominated the curse user, Haruta Shigemo in their fight by creating weak points on his body and striking them with cursed energy enhanced punches.

questions.question: What does the Collapse extension technique do?
questions.subject: Ratio Technique

answer.item: An extension technique that creates a weak point in the surrounding environment, allowing the user to deliver a critical hit to their surrounding area and destroy it.
